'''"Eclipse-Maker" Garthrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] member of the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] pirates living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was killed at the Twin Suns Station in [[Jundland]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen working for the [[Citizens' Militia]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Eclipse-Maker" Garthrus appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the final boss during the staged quest "Quarry Quandary" on Tatooine.
